admin.note: Platform default (A3 L67); no business grant authored.

user.note: Platform default (A3 L67); no business grant authored.

data_scope.rule: All internal roles read all records of every flow they are granted (scope 'all'); v4 defines no record-level isolation for Beiersdorf roles. 'Own lane' on the case and 'own department' on open points are enforced by step ownership and branch-scoped field permissions, not by a row filter. CIQ RMES Safety/Regulatory isolation is by write grant only (the other department reads, REQ-CFG-004). Future views/dashboards (Workbench) must reuse this map.

hard_rules.rule: No pages (--no-pages). Any native page/card on a flow auto-grants its target roles as editors and would break every V cell, in particular CIQ RMES Safety/Regulatory isolation (REQ-CFG-004) and the read-only CIQ Reader.
CIQ Case Admin members must also hold CIQ RMM; Case Admin carries only flow Admin on the three Processes, View on Forms, and write on CIQ Internal Note and CIQ Audit Event.
The supplier has no app role and no grant; portal flows (CIQP *) are never granted here.
CIQ Integration Service never acts on a human step after Start; it initiates CIQ Change Request (Y6) only and writes CIQ Section and CIQ Audit Event rows.
Child tables are keyed at TABLE level only in step permissions; every header field and child table is keyed explicitly at every task step (unlisted = ReadOnly).

satisfiability.note: Derived from the executable grants above: initiator:true only on business-authorized creators; each first step (StartEvent) is Act for exactly the initiators; every other task step is Act for exactly its workflow assignee_role. No flow has zero creators or zero readers.

residual_risks.risk: CIQ Audit Event is written by people (Q3 default), so the claim is 'tamper-evident', not immutable. Until K-17 proves a Form member without Delete, the engine's Editable Form grant may include Delete.
residual_risks.mitigation: Post-generate REST reset to no-Delete; hash chain per A3 L66; the single-writer option (service only) stays available if BDF wants immutability.

residual_risks.risk: Step-owning roles (5 Reviewers on CIQ Case and CIQ Change Request, CIQ Overall Approver on CIQ Case) come out of generate with InitiateItems and can raise items natively until the REST reset.
residual_risks.mitigation: post_generate_grants; the Workbench hides '+ New' for them.

residual_risks.risk: CIQ Open Point Start is Act for RMM and all five Reviewers (v4 L237); the engine assigns the start step's owner as ciq_rmm. Any Reviewer can raise for any department; the owning department is a field (OP_Dept), not a grant.
residual_risks.mitigation: Workbench preselects OP_Dept from the raiser's role; review step ownership (OPNT_R_<D>) enforces 'only the owning department reviews' (REQ-PROC-034).

residual_risks.risk: Form grants are per Form (C4): every CIQ Scope Run / CIQ Internal Note writer can edit every row, including other departments' runs and other authors' notes.
residual_risks.mitigation: Convention (v4 L284 'by convention') plus F8 audit events.

residual_risks.risk: Step-level Mandatory on formula fields (Start_Gate, <D>_Gate, Open_Items_Gate) blocks submit while a count is blank; this is intended (A2 L34) but a native My Tasks user without the Workbench must write the counts by hand.
residual_risks.mitigation: Counts are Editable at the same step (D10, D15).
